name: unimts
paper_title: UniMTS: Unified Pre-training for Motion Time Series
authors: Xiyuan Zhang, Diyan Teng, Ranak Roy Chowdhury, Shuheng Li, Dezhi Hong, Rajesh K. Gupta, Jingbo Shang
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) 2024
license: Paper: CC BY 4.0 (arXiv). Code repo: no LICENSE file present (unknown).
notes: First unified pre-training procedure for motion (IMU) time series that generalizes across device positions/orientations and activities. Method: contrastive learning aligning motion time series with LLM-enriched text descriptions; pre-trained ONLY on synthetic data generated from HumanML3D skeleton motion (converted to BVH then to IMU signals via IMUSim), avoiding need for real labeled sensor data. Uses a spatio-temporal graph encoder for device-location invariance and rotation-invariant augmentation for mounting-orientation robustness. IMU input is 6-dim (acc x/y/z, gyro x/y/z); test uses 10-second windows. Evaluated on 18 real-world HAR benchmark datasets. Reported gains vs baselines: zero-shot +340%, few-shot +16.3%, full-shot +9.2%. Pre-trained model WEIGHTS are on HuggingFace at https://huggingface.co/xiyuanz/UniMTS (note the HF username 'xiyuanz' differs from the GitHub username 'xiyuanzh'). NOTE: original SEED code URL github.com/xiyuanz/UniMTS is a typo and 404s; correct repo is github.com/xiyuanzh/UniMTS. OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=DpByqSbdhI . For HALO cross-check: this is the 'cosine tier' zero-shot/contrastive baseline; note it consumes both accel AND gyro, whereas many HAR datasets/HALO settings may be accel-only.
